dialogue.zh: C：当我拥有你的时候，我待你又坏又错亲爱的。

dialogue.en: C: And since, since you went away,
dialogue.zh: C：自从你离开后，难道你不知道我成天垂头丧气坐着，

dialogue.en: don't you know I sit around with my head hanging down
and I wonder who's loving you.
